verdicts.reason: A breaks proximity: the 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' attribution sits above the can on the right, far from the quote it credits. The logo floats on the purple circle, the quote mark is stranded far above the text, and the quote is jammed against the bottom edge. B keeps the quote mark, quote and attribution together in a clear left-to-right banner with the product centred in a full circle. However, B blows the logo up out of proportion so it outweighs the tiny attribution beside it, and the 'SOLSTICE' can label is barely legible.
